comment: Quality rules for takes (chunk 94). Results are advisory unless the project policy (.ample/quality.json) requires a rule for tag or promote. Thresholds can be changed in the policy.

rules.name: clipping
rules.title: Clipping
rules.explanation: Runs of three or more samples at full scale were found: the sound is distorted. Lower the level of the block or the mix.

rules.name: true-peak
rules.title: True peak
rules.explanation: The reconstructed peak is above -1 dBTP: converting to a lossy format may clip. Leave some headroom.

rules.name: loudness
rules.title: Loudness target
rules.explanation: The integrated loudness is further than the tolerance from the target (default -14 LUFS, within 1.5 LU).

rules.name: silence
rules.title: Silence gaps
rules.explanation: A stretch of silence longer than two seconds inside the song (not the lead-in or the tail).

rules.name: dc-offset
rules.title: DC offset
rules.explanation: The signal is shifted away from zero, which wastes headroom and can click at cuts.

rules.name: format
rules.title: Sample rate
rules.explanation: A final take is not at the project's 44100 Hz (previews at 11025 Hz are expected and are not checked).

rules.name: tempo-key
rules.title: Tempo and key fit
rules.explanation: Needs an analysis plugin (chunk 96). Until one is installed this rule is reported as not run.
